summary: The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a missile from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz at 21:55 local time, posing an immediate threat to maritime security. Simultaneously, IDF combat teams of the South Gaza Brigade identified a militant crossing the yellow line and approaching Israeli forces in Khan Yunis, prompting immediate fire response and confirmed damage. These developments reflect heightened cross-border tension between Iran and Israel with active Israeli defensive operations in southern Gaza.
key_points: On March 25, 2026, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps launched a missile from Sirik toward the Strait of Hormuz at 21:55 local time (1825Z), targeting the strategic waterway (Source: @shin_persian/8950).

On March 24, 2026, IDF combat teams of the South Gaza Brigade identified a militant who crossed the yellow line and approached Israeli forces in Khan Yunis, prompting immediate fire response and confirming damage (Source: @almogboker78/17951).

The Golani Sayeret conducted a continuous series of operational activities in the Bofor area for approximately 50 consecutive days, demonstrating sustained offensive capability in southern Gaza (Source: @idf_telegram/24870).

Israeli military authorities reported receipt of thousands of tons of military equipment, including D9 graders, Humvees, JLTV armored vehicles, and Oshkosh trucks, at the Haifa port following additional shipment arrivals (Source: @naya_foriraq/87683).

Following reduced diplomatic engagement in the region, the United States announced a withdrawal of diplomatic personnel from Middle Eastern missions amid ongoing conflict pressures (Source: @New_security8200/203295).
Israeli settlers engaged in a siege of three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra, employing terror tactics to pressure property owners (Source: @presstv/202604).

US intelligence agencies expressed skepticism regarding an alleged Iranian plot to assassinate President Trump, noting the source originated from Israel and assigning low confidence to the assessment (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6245).
